subject: Gheatmap with tree in fan layout with open angle

messages.author: bfbcc602f0f0e3fa
messages.subject: Gheatmap with tree in fan layout with open angle
parts:
Dear Yu,

First let me thank for your fantastic work on this package.
I never had to ask question in this conversation since the documentation is top notch and I always managed to find a way to do whatever I needed with ggtree.
Recently, though, I hit my first wall.

The issue is shortly described here (not by me, but this is the only ref I found about this specific issue/bug):

https://stackoverflow.com/questions/74076494/gheatmap-seems-to-close-open-angle-for-ggtree

The idea is that, to accommodate the variable names on the heatmap on a circular tree, I would like to use a fan representation with an open angle (30 or 45°) so that the names can lie vertically on the space that is not used by the phylogeny.
But, for now, calling gheatmap on a fan tree with an open angle seems to collapse the angle, for a reason you may able to investigate and maybe sort out.
There's no reason to put that on top of a priority list, but this feature could be useful especially for large matrix.
It would allow us to make similar representation as, e.g. this one from Anvi'o:

I think you get the idea.
Let me know if you feel interested, I can probably cook up a reproductible example with a toy dataset but I am not sure we need it at this point.
Best regards,

Etienne Loire
